title: Reveal on scroll

summary.en: Figures, key numbers and illustrations fade up 4 px the first time they scroll into view, once, and never again. Body text, lists and tables are never revealed: people should be able to read and search everything at once.
summary.id: Gambar, angka kunci, dan ilustrasi memudar naik 4 px saat pertama kali masuk ke layar karena scroll, sekali saja, dan tidak pernah lagi. Teks isi, daftar, dan tabel tidak pernah dimunculkan dengan cara ini: orang harus bisa membaca dan mencari semuanya sekaligus.

en.title: Key numbers on a results page
en.desc: Scroll inside the box. The three figures fade up together with a 30 ms step when they come into view; scroll back and they stay put. Press Replay to watch it again.
en.html:
Citizen reports in October

This month 1,248 reports came in from 20 districts. Scroll down to see how that compares with last month and how many are already resolved.

Road damage reports fell the most. Waste reports are still close to the response deadline, so cleaning crews get extra rounds.

The figures are final once verification ends on Friday.

en.title: Pictures further down a guide
en.desc: Photos in a long service guide fade up as they arrive; the text around them is already there.
en.html:
Getting a business permit at the public service mall

Take a queue number from the machine by the entrance. Bring your KTP, family card and a photo of the business.

Counters open at 07:30 on working days. The waiting room is on the second floor; consultations can be booked a week ahead.

Levy payments are taken from 08:00 to 14:00 at the counter next to building C.

id.title: Angka kunci di halaman hasil
id.desc: Gulir di dalam kotak. Ketiga angka memudar naik bersamaan dengan jarak 30 ms saat masuk ke layar; gulir kembali dan angkanya tetap di tempat. Tekan Putar ulang untuk melihatnya lagi.
id.html:
Laporan warga bulan Oktober

Bulan ini masuk 1.248 laporan dari 20 kecamatan. Gulir ke bawah untuk melihat perbandingannya dengan bulan lalu dan berapa yang sudah selesai ditangani.

Laporan jalan rusak turun paling banyak. Laporan sampah masih mendekati batas waktu tanggap, jadi petugas kebersihan mendapat tambahan jadwal.

Angka ini final setelah masa verifikasi berakhir hari Jumat.

id.html:
Mengurus izin usaha di mal pelayanan publik

Ambil nomor antrean di mesin dekat pintu masuk. Bawa KTP, kartu keluarga, dan foto tempat usaha.

Loket buka pukul 07.30 pada hari kerja. Ruang tunggu ada di lantai dua; konsultasi bisa dipesan seminggu sebelumnya.

Pembayaran retribusi dilayani pukul 08.00 sampai 14.00 di loket sebelah gedung C.
